# ProjectionLineChart

## Overview

The ProjectionLineChart is a complete chart visualization component that supports two projection modes. In **confidence** mode (default), it displays a line chart with an optional confidence/projection band. In **forecast** mode, it renders actual data as a solid line and projected data as a dashed line. It combines ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, ProjectionPathGroup, and ChartFooter components. This component is ideal for forecasting visualizations, prediction intervals, and trend charts with uncertainty ranges.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

All color and stroke tokens are sourced from the CSS cascade: DataVis palette tokens (`--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-{n}`) via `generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection`, and surface/typography tokens via `useBrandCSSNew`. No runtime JS token resolver; no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `221:3814`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=221-3814

## Architecture

```
ProjectionLineChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper)
│   ├── ChartHeader (optional)
│   │   ├── ChartTitle
│   │   └── ChartSubtitle
│   ├── ChartLegend (optional)
│   │   └── ChartKey[] (auto-generated or manual)
│   ├── DataDisplay (optional, when dataDisplay=true)
│   │   ├── contentLeft
│   │   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography)
│   │   │   └── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│   │   └── contentRight (Badge)
│   ├── ProjectionPathGroup (animated → clip-path entry + rAF morph)
│   │   ├── YAxis (optional)
│   │   ├── SVG (clip-path left-to-right reveal when animated)
│   │   │   ├── [confidence] path (projection area) + path (solid line)
│   │   │   └── [forecast] path (solid actual) + path (dashed forecast)
│   │   ├── HoverLine (conditional — toggled by hoverLine)
│   │   │   ├── topHoverDataLabel (optional)
│   │   │   ├── lineIndicator (toggled by hoverLineConfig.lineIndicator)
│   │   │   └── dot (positioned at line intersection)
│   │   │       └── DataBadgeFloatingGroup (toggled by hoverLineConfig.dataBadgeFloatingGroup)
│   │   └── XAxis (optional)
│   └── ChartFooter (optional)
│       └── annotation slots (source + notes)
```

## Import

```tsx
import { ProjectionLineChart } from './charts/ProjectionLineChart';
```

## Data Formats

### ProjectionDataPoint

```typescript
interface ProjectionDataPoint {
  /** Category label (x-axis) — string, number, or Date */
  category: CategoryValue;
  /** Main value (the solid line) */
  value: number;
  /** Upper bound of the confidence interval (confidence mode) */
  upperBound?: number;
  /** Lower bound of the confidence interval (confidence mode) */
  lowerBound?: number;
  /** Whether this point is a projected/forecast point (forecast mode) */
  projected?: boolean;
}
```

### Example Data

Categories accept `string`, `number`, or `Date` values. Date categories are auto-formatted by `formatCategoryLabel()` — `new Date(2024, 0)` → `"2024"`, `new Date(2024, 5)` → `"Jun 2024"`.

```typescript
const projectionData: ProjectionDataPoint[] = [
  { category: new Date(2020, 0), value: 12, lowerBound: 10, upperBound: 14 },
  { category: new Date(2022, 0), value: 14, lowerBound: 11, upperBound: 17 },
  { category: new Date(2024, 0), value: 24, lowerBound: 20, upperBound: 28 },
  { category: new Date(2026, 0), value: 33, lowerBound: 26, upperBound: 40, projected: true },
  { category: new Date(2028, 0), value: 44, lowerBound: 33, upperBound: 55, projected: true },
];
```

## Props Interface (Organized Props Pattern)

```typescript
interface DataDisplayConfig {
  // Chart-specific behaviour
  mode?: 'static' | 'hover';
  formatHoverMainLabel?: (category: CategoryValue) => string;
  formatHoverLeadValue?: (
    value: number,
    category?: CategoryValue,
    bounds?: { upper?: number; lower?: number }
  ) => string;
  formatHoverBadgeValue?: (
    value: number,
    category?: CategoryValue,
    bounds?: { upper?: number; lower?: number }
  ) => string;

  // DataDisplay Layer 2 props
  mainLabelValue?: string;
  alignment?: 'Left' | 'Center';
  rightBadgeWrapper?: boolean;
  badgeTop?: boolean;
  badgeBottom?: boolean;
  showBadge?: boolean;
  supportingBadgeLabel?: boolean;
  supportingBadgeLabelValue?: string;
  size?: 'XS' | 'S' | 'M' | 'L' | 'XL';

  // DataDisplay Layer 3 configs
  dataHead?: DataHeadConfig;
  badgeConfig?: BadgeConfig;
}

interface ProjectionLineChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent component props
  data: ProjectionDataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;
  onHover?: (hoverData: ProjectionHoverData | null) => void;

  // Layer 3: Child component configurations
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  projectionPathGroupConfig?: ProjectionPathGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  // Accessibility
  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Usage

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Q1', value: 10, lowerBound: 8, upperBound: 12 },
    { category: 'Q2', value: 15, lowerBound: 11, upperBound: 20 },
    { category: 'Q3', value: 22, lowerBound: 15, upperBound: 30 },
    { category: 'Q4', value: 32, lowerBound: 20, upperBound: 45 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Projection',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Quarterly forecast with confidence interval',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Configuration

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={projectionData}
  width={400}
  height={300}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Growth Projection',
    chartSubtitleValue: '5-year forecast with confidence bands',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    projectionLabel: 'Base case',
    projectionBandLabel: 'Range (low to high)',
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: {
      lineIndicator: true,
      dataBadgeFloatingGroup: true,
      formatHoverBadgeValue: (value) => `£${value.toFixed(1)}M`,
    },
    snapToData: true,
    curveStyle: 'Curved',
    yAxisConfig: { tickCount: 5 },
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Finance Team',
    annotationRightValue: 'Updated quarterly',
  }}
  onHover={(data) => console.log(data)}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  height={300}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Full Width Chart' }}
/>
```

### Forecast Mode

In forecast mode, actual data points are rendered as a solid line and projected points as a dashed line. The HoverLine auto-positions at the actual→projected boundary on mount.

```tsx
const forecastData: ProjectionDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: 100 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Mar', value: 115 },
  { category: 'Apr', value: 130 },
  { category: 'May', value: 145, projected: true },
  { category: 'Jun', value: 160, projected: true },
];

<ProjectionLineChart
  data={forecastData}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Forecast',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Actual vs projected revenue',
  }}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    actualLabel: 'Revenue',
    forecastLabel: 'Projected',
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'forecast',
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

### With Entry Animation

When `animated` is `true`, paths and the confidence band reveal with a left-to-right clip-path animation on first load. Data changes morph the paths smoothly via `requestAnimationFrame`.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  animated
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Animated Projection' }}
/>
```

### With Date Categories

When `category` values are `Date` objects, XAxis and DataDisplay auto-format them via `formatCategoryLabel()`.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={[
    { category: new Date(2020, 0), value: 12, lowerBound: 10, upperBound: 14 },
    { category: new Date(2025, 0), value: 28, lowerBound: 23, upperBound: 33 },
    { category: new Date(2030, 0), value: 57, lowerBound: 40, upperBound: 74, projected: true },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Growth Projection 2020–2030' }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'confidence',
    xAxisConfig: { tickCount: 5 },
  }}
/>
```

### With Custom Legend Items

Legend item colors must be CSS custom property strings — never hex literals — so they respond to brand switches.

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  chartLegendConfig={{
    items: [
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Base case', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)', type: 'line' },
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Uncertainty range', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-1)', type: 'circle' },
      { categoryLabelValue: 'Historical', color: 'var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-2)', type: 'dashed' },
    ],
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Static Mode)

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Projection' }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Projected total',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '£2,390M',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingData: true,
    },
    badgeConfig: { value: '+23.5%' },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

DataDisplay updates dynamically when hovering over the projection line. `mainLabelValue` shows the hovered category formatted via `formatCategoryLabel` by default (or your custom `formatHoverMainLabel`).

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={confidenceData}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover to see values',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => value.toFixed(1),
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value, _category, bounds) => {
      if (bounds?.upper !== undefined && bounds.lower !== undefined) {
        return `±${((bounds.upper - bounds.lower) / 2).toFixed(1)}`;
      }
      return `${Math.round(value)}`;
    },
  }}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    projectionMode: 'confidence',
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: { lineIndicator: true, dataBadgeFloatingGroup: false },
  }}
/>
```

### With Custom Main Label Format on Hover

Override the default `formatCategoryLabel` with your own format string:

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={monthlyData}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a point',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    // Show "Jun 2024" instead of the year-only default for monthly dates
    formatHoverMainLabel: (category) =>
      category instanceof Date
        ? category.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })
        : String(category),
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
  }}
/>
```

### With Y-Axis Value Formatting

```tsx
// Percentage format
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={percentageData}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: { valueFormat: { type: 'percentage' } },
  }}
/>

// Currency format
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={currencyData}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    yAxisConfig: {
      valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With Hover Callback

```tsx
const [hoverData, setHoverData] = useState<ProjectionHoverData | null>(null);

<ProjectionLineChart data={data} onHover={setHoverData} />;

{hoverData && (
  <div>
    Category: {String(hoverData.category)}
    Value: {hoverData.value.toFixed(2)}
    {hoverData.upperBound && `Upper: ${hoverData.upperBound}`}
    {hoverData.lowerBound && `Lower: ${hoverData.lowerBound}`}
  </div>
)}
```

### With Data Sorting

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{ dataSort: 'asc' }}
/>
```

### With Top Hover Data Label

```tsx
<ProjectionLineChart
  data={data}
  projectionPathGroupConfig={{
    hoverLine: true,
    hoverLineConfig: {
      topHoverDataLabel: true,
      formatTopHoverDataLabel: (category) => `Quarter: ${String(category)}`,
    },
    snapToData: true,
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens

All values come from the CSS cascade. No hard-coded pixels or hex colors in the component.

| Property      | Token                                                       | Source              |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| Container gap | `--ProjectionLineChart-gap` → `--Spacing-5`                 | OneUI system tokens |
| Line color    | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)`                         | generateDataVisCSS  |
| Band color    | `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Subtle-1)`                       | generateDataVisCSS  |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend={true}` and no manual `items` are provided, legend items are auto-generated from the active `projectionMode`:

- **Confidence mode** (default): Solid line key (`projectionLabel`, default `"Projection"`) + circle key (`projectionBandLabel`, default `"Confidence interval"`) when data has `upperBound`/`lowerBound` values.
- **Forecast mode**: Solid line key (`actualLabel`, default `"Actual"`) + dashed line key (`forecastLabel`, default `"Forecast"`).

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total height** of the ProjectionLineChart container. ProjectionPathGroup stretches to fill the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer are rendered.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)       │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                       │
│       ProjectionPathGroup             │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│   (YAxis + Line + Area + XAxis)       │
│                                       │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (source + notes)         │  ← Auto height
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
        Total height: `height` prop
```

## DataDisplay Hover Mode

When `dataDisplayConfig.mode = 'hover'`, three values update dynamically as the line is hovered:

| Field            | Default behaviour                                   | Override via                      |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue` | `formatCategoryLabel(category)` — year for Jan-1 dates | `formatHoverMainLabel`        |
| `dataLeadValue`  | `value.toLocaleString()`                            | `formatHoverLeadValue`            |
| `badgeConfig.value` | `±half-range` (confidence) or `% of total` (forecast) | `formatHoverBadgeValue`    |

The static `mainLabelValue` from props is used as a fallback when no data point is hovered yet.

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Provides `role="figure"`, ARIA attributes, auto-generated summaries, a hidden data table, and an `aria-live` region for hover announcements.

### ARIA Live Region

Announces hovered data points to screen readers:

- **Without bounds**: `"Q3, 22"`
- **With bounds**: `"Q3, 22, range 15 to 30"`
- **Projected point**: `"May, 145, projected"`

### DataDisplay aria-controls Wiring

When `dataDisplay={true}`, a stable `dataDisplayId` from `useChartAccessibility` links each focusable data point to the DataDisplay region via `aria-controls`.

### Keyboard Navigation

Handled by `ProjectionPathGroup` via `useRovingTabIndex`. See [ProjectionPathGroup.md](./ProjectionPathGroup.md).

### Decorative Elements

All decorative elements (axes, SVG paths, HoverLine) are `aria-hidden="true"`. Their data is conveyed through the hidden table and ARIA live announcements.
